universe: all thirty instruments at the initial annual snapshot: ten held target calls and twenty hedge calls
acceptance: All individual native and independent price checks, signed held-book joint SE <= 10, then the existing solver and lot-rounded proposed-book gate. Both seeds must pass; retain failures. No seed substitution or threshold relaxation.
scope: Single frozen annual market and European calls only. Path-dependent products, subsequent dates, and normal-provider policy promotion require separate evidence.
